rules: BOOT.md is a generated pointer map and stays within its line and character budget.
Holdout samples must remain locked; agents may read their metadata only.
Recursive entry files are forbidden; update sources instead of adding another entry file.
No external side effects (payments, deployments, account changes) without explicit human approval.
Generated summaries never outrank their sources.
Raw evidence is read as a pointer unless an audit needs the content.
Later information must not leak into earlier recorded judgments.
